description:
Generates AI-grounded answers backed by real-time Brave Search using the Answers API. Returns the finished answer as markdown.

    Preferred replacement for brave_summarizer: Pass your question in query instead of chaining brave_web_search (summary: true) + brave_summarizer.

    When to use:
        - When you need a finished, web-grounded answer rather than raw search results
        - For quick factual Q&A with optional citations (enable_citations), returned as markdown footnotes
        - For deeper multi-search research on complex topics (enable_research)

    Two modes:
        - Single-search (default): Fast grounded answer from one search. Supports enable_citations.
        - Research (enable_research=true): Iterative multi-search synthesis. Slower; may take up to several minutes.

    Requires an Answers plan. See https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/subscriptions/subscribe

enable_citations.description: Include inline citations, rendered as markdown footnotes. Not supported in research mode.

enable_entities.description: Request inline entity tags in the answer. Not supported in research mode. The API has not been observed to return entity tags, so this may have no effect.

enable_research.description: Answer with iterative multi-search research instead of a single search. Slower; may take several minutes.

max_completion_tokens.description: Upper bound on completion tokens. An answer cut off at this limit ends with a note saying so.

model.description: The Answers model to use. Omit to use the API default.

query.description: The question to answer. Sent to the Answers API as the single user message.

research_maximum_number_of_iterations.description: Research mode only. Maximum research iterations (1-5).

research_maximum_number_of_queries.description: Research mode only. Maximum total search queries during research (1-50).

research_maximum_number_of_results_per_q.description: Research mode only. Maximum results per search query during research (1-60). The API default is 30.

research_maximum_number_of_seconds.description: Research mode only. Research time budget in seconds (1-300).

research_maximum_number_of_tokens_per_qu.description: Research mode only. Maximum tokens per research query (1024-16384).

web_search_options.description: OpenAI-compatible web search options: search context size and approximate user location.

search_context_size.description: Amount of search context to retrieve for grounding.

user_location.description: Approximate location parameters to refine search results based on geography.

city.description: Free text input for the city of the user, e.g. "San Francisco".

country.description: The two-letter ISO country code of the user, e.g. "US".

region.description: Free text input for the region of the user, e.g. "California".

timezone.description: The IANA timezone of the user, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles".

type.description: The type of location approximation. Only "approximate" is supported.
